title: Most x402 Payments Aren't From AI Agents
author: PYMNTS (citing TRM Labs)
key_passages: TRM examined about $52.7 million in value across 198.9 million x402 settlement transactions
just 0.6% to 7.5% of the remaining payment value appeared to be agentic
That reduced the original $52.7 million to $25.62 million of likely commerce
$52.47 million of $52.68 million in settled value, or 99.6%, used USDC
relevance: Critical counter-evidence: most x402 payments are NOT from AI agents.
